items.title: Project Fetch: Phase two
items.summary: We report results from our latest test of whether Claude can help Anthropic employees perform sophisticated robotics tasks. We found that Claude Opus 4.7, operating without human assistance, was about 20 times faster than the fastest human team at all tasks completed by participants less than a year ago.

items.title: Frontier Red Team
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team stress-tests AI systems to understand the full extent of their current capabilities and anticipate what comes next. We provide evidence-based analysis about AI’s implications for cybersecurity, national security, and autonomous systems.
items.title_ko: Frontier Red Team
items.summary_ko: Anthropic의 Frontier Red Team이 AI 시스템을 스트레스 테스트해 현재 역량의 전체 범위를 파악하고 다음에 올 변화를 예측. 사이버보안 · 국가안보 · 자율 시스템 측면에서 AI의 함의를 근거 기반으로 분석합니다.

items.title: Assessing Claude Mythos Preview’s cybersecurity capabilities
items.summary: Claude Mythos Preview is a new general-purpose language model that is strikingly capable at computer security tasks. This post provides technical details for researchers and practitioners who want to understand exactly how we have been testing this model, and what we have found over the past month.
items.title_ko: Claude Mythos Preview의 사이버보안 역량 평가
items.summary_ko: Claude Mythos Preview는 컴퓨터 보안 작업에서 두드러진 능력을 보이는 신규 범용 언어모델. 지난 한 달간의 테스트 방법론과 발견 결과를 연구자·실무자를 위해 기술적으로 정리.

items.title: Developing Nuclear Safeguards for AI
items.summary: Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an AI system that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign nuclear-related conversations with high accuracy in preliminary testing.
items.title_ko: AI를 위한 핵 안전장치(Nuclear Safeguards) 개발
items.summary_ko: NNSA 및 DOE 국립연구소와 공동으로 분류기(AI 시스템)를 개발 — 핵 관련 대화를 우려되는 것 vs 무해한 것으로 자동 구분, 초기 테스트에서 높은 정확도를 보였습니다.

items.title: Measuring LLMs' impact on N-day exploits
items.summary: In cybersecurity, a large fraction of real-world harm comes from N-days: vulnerabilities that have already been publicly disclosed, but only patched on some devices. In this post, we evaluate how much large language models can accelerate and automate the process of developing N-day exploits.
items.title_ko: LLM이 N-day 익스플로잇에 미치는 영향 측정
items.summary_ko: 사이버보안 피해의 상당 부분은 N-day(공개됐지만 일부 단말에만 패치된 취약점)에서 발생. 대형 언어모델이 N-day 익스플로잇 개발을 얼마나 가속·자동화하는지를 평가합니다.

items.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator
items.summary: We’ve spent the past year investigating how threat actors are weaponizing AI to conduct cyber operations. Today, we’re sharing a new analysis that maps these real-world attacks onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework, a database of tactics and techniques used by cyberattackers.
items.title_ko: AI 기반 사이버 위협 매핑 — LLM ATT&CK Navigator의 통찰
items.summary_ko: 지난 1년간 위협 행위자들이 AI를 사이버 작전에 어떻게 무기화했는지 조사한 결과를, 공격자 전술·기법 데이터베이스 MITRE ATT&CK 프레임워크에 매핑한 분석을 공개합니다.

items.title: Developing nuclear safeguards for AI through public-private partnership
items.summary: Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an AI system that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign nuclear-related conversations with 96% accuracy in preliminary testing.

items.title: Core views on AI safety: When, why, what, and how
items.summary: AI progress may lead to transformative AI systems in the next decade, but we do not yet understand how to make such systems safe and aligned with human values. In response, we are pursuing a variety of research directions aimed at better understanding, evaluating, and aligning AI systems.
items.title_ko: AI 안전성에 대한 핵심 견해 — 언제·왜·무엇을·어떻게
items.summary_ko: AI 발전은 향후 10년 내 변혁적 AI 시스템으로 이어질 수 있지만, 그러한 시스템을 안전하게 만들고 인간 가치와 정렬하는 방법은 아직 모릅니다. 이를 위해 Anthropic이 추구하는 여러 연구 방향을 정리한 문서.

items.summary: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
